chapter: Jules's band and the move north
title: Art Landry the MC, judged a phony
summary: Bauduc identifies Art Landry as the MC who made big promises to Jules's band that came to nothing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Yeah, well, I, I'll bring up a name, did you ever know Art Landry?
He didn't play anything, he was the MC.

He was the MC at, that, that, uh, at the, uh, uh, Saga Theater, and my brother Jules' band worked with him, and that's the band that, uh, went, went to New York, see, and he gave him that big talk, you know, fast talk, I don't know whether you know, know Landry well, I met him a couple of times, I could tell right off the bat, I said he was a phony, you know what I mean?
They give you that, that big mouth and nothing happens, so, so that's what happened with, with that band.
Well, I, I just happened to have read something about Landry and the, uh, in the, in the musicians, the unions book.
